entries.name: Broken Access Control
entries.outcome: Enforce authorization consistently; deny by default; prevent IDOR and privilege escalation.

entries.name: Security Misconfiguration
entries.outcome: Harden defaults, cloud/IAM config, headers, and unnecessary features.

entries.name: Software Supply Chain Failures
entries.outcome: Prove provenance of dependencies, build pipelines, and third-party components.

entries.name: Cryptographic Failures
entries.outcome: Use modern crypto correctly; protect data at rest and in transit.

entries.name: Injection
entries.outcome: Separate code from data; validate/encode inputs for interpreters.

entries.name: Insecure Design
entries.outcome: Threat-model early; design for abuse cases and trust boundaries.

entries.name: Authentication Failures
entries.outcome: Strong identity proofing, session management, MFA, and credential handling.

entries.name: Software or Data Integrity Failures
entries.outcome: Protect CI/CD, updates, and critical data from unauthorized modification.

entries.name: Security Logging and Alerting Failures
entries.outcome: Log security-relevant events and alert on actionable signals.

entries.name: Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions
entries.outcome: Handle errors and edge conditions safely without leaking control or data.
